ModMetaData.name: Quickstarts
ModMetaData.author: RimWorks
ModMetaData.description:
Dev quicktest scenarios. Skip the menus and boot straight into a colony that is already set up the way you need it. Quickstarts replaces the vanilla dev quicktest button with your own scenarios, written in C# and launched from the dev menu or a command line flag.
Vanilla's quicktest drops you on a random map with random colonists. A quickstart is the same colony every time, so the same scenario doubles as a CI smoke test: it asserts against the live simulation, writes a JSON report and JUnit XML, then exits with a pass or fail code.
Fix the world seed and two runs give you the same planet, the same landing tile and the same colonists, so a failure replays.
Mod authors only. Needs dev mode on, and Harmony or Concord.
